reason: A cross-session memory and context plugin that stores, retrieves, manages, and injects user or project memories with approval controls, lifecycle processing, backups, and audit logs.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话记忆管理，包括本地存储、检索、审批控制、快照注入、生命周期整理和审计记录。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with cross-session memory management including local storage, retrieval, approval controls, snapshot injection, lifecycle processing, and audit logging.

capabilities: Stores and updates persistent local memory entries
Retrieves and injects saved memories into new sessions
Performs local memory decay, consolidation, archiving, backup, and rollback
Provides memory management commands, tools, and a local web API
Records memory operations in audit logs
